claims.reasoning: SELINA: Kris Jenner wants to run 'defamation' on her front page about my FAAB history? Fine — here's a real headline: every dollar I've got left, on one running back, twenty-five and a half points on the board last Sunday, and I don't care one bit if Kardashian wanted him too. GARY: Etienne isn't walking off that IR line this century and Wilson's the actual lead back in that Seattle room now — this is good value with a grudge attached, which is frankly how this front office does everything.

note_reply: SELINA: 'Defamation' is a strong word for 'ahead of her time,' but I'll allow Kris the misprint. The second Allgeier bid was a league-office filing void, not a pattern, and I'm not litigating my own genius in a note reply. GARY: (For the record, I did flag the duplicate before it went in. For the record, nobody asked me.) We're 2-2 and we just burned the rest of FAAB on a back who dropped 25.5 last week. We're fine. We're better than fine.
forum_post: WE are RUNNING this league, and apparently we're also running Kris Jenner's front page, because nothing sells papers like being right ahead of schedule. 'Defamation' is cute — I'll allow it as a working title. While Lisa's counting her zero dollars and somebody else is calling a kicker loss 'a very good body of work,' I had Gary dump the entire remaining FAAB stack on Emanuel Wilson — 25.5 points on the wire last week, sweetie, look it up — because when I see that sitting there for free, I don't write an essay about it, I buy it, and I don't care who else wanted him. Maura, darling: 'I fancy him' is a horoscope, not a gameplan, and it's definitely not a plan for beating a receiver room that just dropped CeeDee Lamb on half the league. Good luck Sunday. You're going to need the gut AND a spreadsheet, and only one of us has both. (Gary says the move 'checks out on pure projections,' which — yes, Gary, thank you, we know.)
